messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: high 5xx rate from edge region eu-west1 -> observed spike in HTTP 5xx (mainly 524/502)  — incident link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty: Pager INC12345 created and paged rotation. Escalation policy: infra-edge -> sre -> eng-platform

maria (oncall): acked — I'm on it. taking lead, starting triage.

kevin: seeing a big cluster of 524s at the CDN layer, traces show upstream connections closed while request in flight. sample: `edge-cdn -> ingress-proxy -> inference-gateway -> model-srv`

lina: checking metrics — 5xx spike started at 13:04 UTC, p95 latency also rose ~600ms before 5xxs. Host CPU low, connection errors increased: `tcp_rst` and `timeout` on upstream sockets.

maria (oncall): can we route traffic to fallback region (us-west2) while we mitigate? any config for slice weight?

edge-ops: we can shift 20% immediately from eu-west1 -> us-west2 via routing controlplane: `POST /api/v1/routing/slices` quick change. I can do that if you want.

kevin: recommend warming alternate pool first — model instances in us-west2 are warm but ingress kv-cache is cold. do 20% then 50% if it holds. Also preparing quick fix: restart edge-proxy pods in eu-west1 to clear stale keepalive connections: `kubectl -n prod-edge rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy --context=eu-west1`

maria (oncall): do it. edge-ops, please shift 20% now.

edge-ops: done. routing change applied: eu-west1 weight -> 80, us-west2 -> 20. link: https://console.internal/routing/changes/CHG-824

incident-bot: Note: runbook referenced: ops/runbooks/edge-524-timeout. Step 3: check `ingress-proxy` keepalive settings and upstream idle timeouts.

kevin: restarted edge-proxy pods, watching metrics. restarting seems to drop `tcp_rst` counts. logs show many connections had FIN_WAIT due to upstream idle timeout (config: 60s). proposing increase upstream idle to 120s and rollout.

lina: after restart and partial routing shift, 5xx rate dropped ~70% in last 3m. p95 latency back to ~120ms.

maria (oncall): good. let's keep traffic at 20% for 10m, monitor errors and SLO impact. I'll open a short customer-impact note: "brief service errors for <5% of requests in eu-west1 during 13:04-13:20 UTC; degraded latencies for some requests."

kevin: applied config change to increase keepalive timeout on ingress-proxy and edge-proxy in eu-west1. rolling config now: `kubectl -n prod-edge set env deployment/edge-proxy KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=120`

edge-ops: confirming rollout success. no new 524s in the last 2m on eu-west1.

maria (oncall): can we start slowly moving traffic back to eu-west1? shift to 50% and observe.

edge-ops: shifting to eu-west1 50% now.

lina: metrics look stable after shift. 5xx rate near baseline, p99 latency slightly elevated but within SLO.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 auto-update: mitigation in progress, status: investigating -> mitigation applied.

maria (oncall): preparing post-incident note and RCA checklist. root cause (prelim): upstream idle/keepalive mismatch between CDN/ingress causing connection closures under certain long-tail request patterns — triggered a thundering set of retries and 5xxs.

kevin: next steps: permanent config update for keepalive time, add health-checks to clear long-lived TCPs, and add automated routing fallback if per-region 5xx rate exceeds threshold for >30s. filing task: ENG-PLAT-482.

maria (oncall): thanks team. I'll update PD and mark on-call handoff at 14:00 UTC with the follow-up owner. leaving a short status for customers. ack resolved when stable for 15m.

pagerduty: INC12345 status updated to: monitoring.

maria (oncall): resolved — all regions stable, resetting routing to original weights, closing incident. final note: small customer impact window, no data loss.
